verdict.rationale: Weaviate's first-party replication-architecture docs say a replication factor > 1 replicates data across a multi-node cluster for high availability, which covers the core replication-for-HA part of the story. Nothing in the pack describes the consistency model the story explicitly asks for, or replication across zones. Missing for 10: documented consistency model (e.g., tunable read/write consistency levels), zone- or region-aware replica placement, independent or hands-on corroboration of failover behavior.
